g.text: Lesson 1.7 step 01 night light (ESP32-S3): the Light slider on the right, hold the PIR button
firmware: dark below 1.38 V, light above 1.86 V
firmware timer: while OUT is HIGH the switch keeps 100 uF full (lastMotionMs = now);
after OUT falls the resistor drains it, 1.0 V is reached after 15 s -> TIMEOUT
firmware rule: on = dark AND motion, off = TIMEOUT
the NOR latch is the 'on' variable: light alone never switches it off
B: BC547 stage, 3.3 V -> 5 V on IN
relay module: 1k, PNP, coil 70 Ohm, diode, LED
